summary: Treat every non-black/non-gray cell as part of one filled color key. Detect the row and column periods of the separate lattice of gray shapes. For each gray cell, use its tile-row and tile-column index to read the corresponding key cell and replace gray with that color. Preserve the key and every non-gray cell.
